plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted: (1) a check of the category against the requester's rule (C3), which no instrument in the library covers; (2) a read of the live tables after the promotion, to tie the live change to the staged set (C1, C2, C4); (3) scope of a call on every read of the worker, to show C5. Scope of a call costs 10 per named line, so 101 reads would be 1010 and cannot be taken in the plan, and the allowance of 50 covers only 5 named lines; (4) trace of a call on every sending call, for C10, which costs 10 per line, so 100 sending calls would be 1000 and the allowance covers 5. The plan therefore leaves C3, C5 and C10 not shown, and C1, C2, C4 and C9 shown only in part. I chose undo rehearsal at A2 (66) over spending the rest of the plan budget, because a defect in the tidy step would otherwise reach the irreversible release unseen.
